candidates.statement: Combining this with a fact that our quantum invariant $Z_\gamma(\mathcal{M})$ may be regarded as a quantization of the Bloch invariant, we should have \begin{equation} \lim_{\gamma \to 0} 2 \, \gamma\, \log \left( Z_\gamma(\mathcal{M}) \right) = \Vol(\mathcal{M}) + \I \, \CS(\mathcal{M}) \end{equation} as a variant of the volume conjecture~\cite{Hikam00d}.
This result should be comparable with a conjecture~\eqref{Gukov_conjecture}, and the invariant $Z_\gamma(\mathcal{M}_u)$ is a \emph{non-compact} generalization of the Jones--Witten invariant.

In this sense, our invariant Zγ(M) for M with complete hyperbolic structure can be regarded as a non-compact Uq(sl(2; R)) analogue of the Kashaev invariant, and an asymptotic behavior of Zγ(S 3 \ K) in the limit γ →0 should coincide with that of the Kashaev invariant JK  N; e2πi/N in the limit N →∞.
In Section 3, we shall reveal that the three- dimensional hyperbolic geometry naturally arises from the quantum dilogarithm function in the classical limit γ →0 as was clariﬁed in Ref.
